items.summary: I turn 'it works in the lab' into 'it performs real work'. For the past 16+ years I have helped physical AI companies through the hardest transition they will face: R&D→real deployable product → scale.
items.content_html:
I turn 'it works in the lab' into 'it performs real work'.

For the past 16+ years I have helped physical AI companies through the hardest transition they will face: R&D→real deployable product → scale.

Ex Kiva Systems (Amazon.com), nuTonomy/Motional, current: Kodiak AI. 

Where I'm most useful: startups that need a generalist who is creative, deeply technical, and able to sit with a customer and get to the heart of what they actually need. Then I roll up my sleeves, work shoulder to shoulder with the engineers, and get it shipped.

Where I'm not the right fit: roles that are mostly about directing from a distance, where leadership means pushing timelines from behind a desk rather than being in the work. I lead from inside the team, not above it.

How I lead: Low ego. I teach rather than dictate, because a team trusted with responsibility outperforms one that just follows orders. I do the work alongside my team. What motivates me most is finding people opportunities to grow and making sure they get recognized for it.

items.title: Kodiak AI
items.summary: As Head of Product at Kodiak, I helped build and launch the world's first driverless commercial trucking fleet, now running 24/7 in the Permian Basin. I am currently leading Product for Kodiak Defense, applying that…
items.content_html:
As Head of Product at Kodiak, I helped build and launch the world's first driverless commercial trucking fleet, now running 24/7 in the Permian Basin. I am currently leading Product for Kodiak Defense, applying that same autonomy stack to ground autonomy programs for the US Army, US Marines, and NATO. I help build and nurture close partnerships with major defense primes and OEMs including Textron, GDLS, and US vehicle OEMs.

Kodiak ‐ Head of Product, Defense 2025 - Present

  • Driving product management for military ground robotics for US Army, US Marines, and NATO countries.
  • Supporting business development, commercial and technical partnerships with leading defense primes and suppliers. 

Kodiak ‐ Head of Product: Autonomous Trucking for Commercial, and Industrial 2022 - 2025

  • Lead and grew Product and Technical Program Management teams for Level 4 Class 8 self driving trucking.
  • Working directly with customers to understand existing processes and develop custom solutions.

items.title: Motional / Aptiv / nuTonomy
items.summary: I joined nuTonomy as its first Product Manager (around the time of its acquisition by Delphi/Aptiv) helping the R&D heavy team ship its first driverless product. As Senior Product Director at the resulting Motional, I…
items.content_html:
I joined nuTonomy as its first Product Manager (around the time of its acquisition by Delphi/Aptiv) helping the R&D heavy team ship its first driverless product. As Senior Product Director at the resulting Motional, I led product and industrial design for our first driver-out robotaxi deployment (2021), and partnered with Hyundai in South Korea to co-develop the award winning IONIQ 5 robotaxi.

Motional - Senior Product Director: Level 4 Robotaxi and Last Mile Delivery in Las Vegas & LA 2020 – 2022

  • Lead Industrial Design and UX prototyping, to design and produce the Motional Ioniq 5 Robotaxi with Hyundai.
  • Lead requirements and market analysis for Level 4 automation and B2B integration with Lyft and Uber.

Article: WSJ Robotaxi user experience 

nuTonomy - Senior Product Manager: Level 4 Robotaxi (Boston, Singapore, and Las Vegas) 2018 - 2020 

  • Product strategy, requirements and product development to move from R&D to first driverless product in 2020.
  • Technical partnerships including Tier 1, 2 and OEMs (BMW, FCA, Hyundai and component suppliers).
  • Collaboration with customers (e.g. Lyft, Uber, Grab, Via) to create custom solutions and define system integrations

items.content_html:
CyPhy Works - Vice President of Product 2017 - 2018

I was VP of Product at CyPhy Works, building autonomous ISR drones for the US Army and Navy SOCOM: my first experience taking a defense product from R&D to fielded, wartime use.

  • Product Development & Strategy for PARC -  Persistent Aerial Reconnaissance and Communications - drone ISR, communications relay, and delivery drones.
  • Supported BD with US Army & Navy special forces (SOCOM), Red Cross, Police, Customs & Border Patrol, UPS.

items.title: Kiva Systems / Amazon Robotics
items.summary: I was on the founding product team at Kiva Systems, building the robotic warehouse systems that Amazon acquired for $775M, which became the backbone of Amazon Robotics. I helped scale that technology across Amazon's fulfillment…
items.content_html:
I was on the founding product team at Kiva Systems, building the robotic warehouse systems that Amazon acquired for $775M, which became the backbone of Amazon Robotics. I helped scale that technology across Amazon's fulfillment network: cutting costs, deploying new robotics systems, and increasing performance (1M+ bots deployed globally today). We succeeded with a low ego, high execution team, inspired and trusted to deliver. I led a team of product managers, mechanical engineers, and TPMs.

Product Manager, Kiva Systems (pre Amazon.com acquisition) 2010 – 2012

  • Requirements and human-machine interface design for pioneering warehouse robotics solution.
  • Direct engagement / boots on ground  with customers including Diapers.com, The Gap for product feedback.

Senior Technical Product Manager, Amazon Robotics 2012 – 2013

  • Design and development of Amazon’s first Kiva-enabled robotics fulfillment centers. Customer: Amazon Global Operations.

Product / TPM, Mechanical Engineering Lead, Automation & Robotics Advanced Programs (XB-15) 2013 – 2017

  • Next-gen warehouse robotics and automation including Kiva Systems robotics, AS&RS and robotic arms. 
  • Solution design & deployment of full scale building automation (1M sq ft), and hands-on support through peak operations.

items.title: GIS / Mapping Roles
items.summary: GIS Analyst, Product Manager, BT Global Access - 2002 - 2007 GIS and database modeling for commercial fiber Access pricing across 25 global countries down to street level. Competitive pricing analysis for pricing policies, working…
items.content_html:
GIS Analyst, Product Manager, BT Global Access  - 2002 - 2007

  • GIS and database modeling for commercial fiber Access pricing across 25 global countries down to street level.
  • Competitive pricing analysis for pricing policies, working with global account managers and product managers to set pricing for networks. 
  • Promoted to Product Manager to drive specifications for real-time global access pricing engine.

GIS Consultant, Chris Britton Consultancy / Mouchel (Civil Engineering) serving UK Highways agencies 2001-2002

  • Mapping systems development to support major UK managed motorway networks.
  • Supported the roll-out of the first smart motorway network coupling real time traffic sensing and monitoring with dynamic speed limits to reduce delays, accidents and improve traffic flow. 
  • Initiated stand-up of GIS for managing the M25 roadway network, created vector network topology from self-commissioned aerial survey.
  • Supported development of web-enabled GIS tool to aid rapid response teams.
  • Supported roadside surveys with Differential GPS equipment for construction and environmental protection.
  • Trained GIS technicians in Perth, Scotland to digitize road network for national truck-based road condition survey.

items.title: Education
items.summary: My path into physical AI started with maps. I hold a Master's in Geographical Information Science (Distinction) from the University of Nottingham, and a BSc in Geography and Topographic Science from Swansea University. While my…
items.content_html:
My path into physical AI started with maps. I hold a Master's in Geographical Information Science (Distinction) from the University of Nottingham, and a BSc in Geography and Topographic Science from Swansea University. While my studies in the technical challenges of sensing, mapping and localization were before the time of integration into robotics, this foundation has served me well in every application of automation.

Education:

  • MSc (Distinction) Geographical Information Science, University of Nottingham, UK
  • BSc (Hons) Geography and Topographic Science, University of Wales Swansea, UK
